notes.subject: duw
notes.rationale: תקוה is literally a cord (attachment); figuratively 'expectancy' — the cord picture is lost in 'duw'.

notes.subject: O cogo
notes.rationale: ו‍'and it came to pass' marks result of the previous verse; rendered as connective 'so'.

notes.subject: עולתה … פיה
notes.rationale: 'Unrighteousness shuts her mouth' — personified evil silenced; feminine suffix -ה on the noun carries the personification.

translation: O cogo, mɔgɔ fitiniw bɛ duw sɔrɔ, ani juguya ka a da togi.
